description: This file implements a RecyclerView.Adapter named CategoryAdapter for displaying and managing categories within an Android application. It handles creating view holders, binding category data to views, and managing user interactions such as selecting, adding, or clearing categories.
external_files: R (resources, e.g., layout and drawable files)

classes.name: CategoryAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter subclass managing category items, including special items for adding and clearing categories. It provides methods to set category data and handle user interactions via listener interface.

methods.name: CategoryAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and listener.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CategoryViewHolder by inflating item_category layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds category data to the view holder, handling different item types based on category id.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of categories.

methods.name: setCategoryList
methods.description: Updates the category list with provided categories and manages special items based on current search string.

inner_classes.name: CategoryViewHolder
inner_classes.description: View holder class for category items, providing access to views via ViewBinding.

methods.name: setCategoryList
methods.description: Sets and updates the internal list of categories, adding special 'clear' and 'add' items based on current search input.
